data.one_liner: Generates Dart model classes from JSON strings via command line
data.what_it_does: This package parses a JSON file and outputs Dart model classes with toJson and fromJson methods. It supports null safety, optional and final fields, and handles keys that are not valid Dart identifiers.
use_when: You need to quickly generate typed models from a JSON schema
You want compile‑time safety for JSON data
You are prototyping a Flutter app and want to avoid manual boilerplate
avoid_when: You prefer hand‑written models for fine‑grained control
You need runtime JSON parsing without code generation
You are building a library that must not depend on a code‑generation tool
strengths: Supports null safety and optional fields
Handles non‑identifier keys and integer values for double fields
Command‑line tool is easy to use
weaknesses: Only a command‑line tool, not integrated with build_runner
No support for runtime JSON parsing
Requires manual regeneration when JSON changes
data.setup_notes: Run `run(['--src=example/json', '--dst=example/lib/models']);` or use the CLI `json2model` command
